question: ______ is a legal declaration of a person who is unable to pay off debts.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bankruptcy**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The legal status of an entity or a person where the debt owed to the creditors cannot be repaid is known as **Bankruptcy**.
 
• It is important to note that bankruptcy is not synonymous with **insolvency**.
 
• Insolvency is a state of financial distress in which a business or person is unable to pay its bills or debts.
 
• The **Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (IBC) **is the bankruptcy law of India which seeks to consolidate the existing framework by creating a single law for insolvency and bankruptcy.
